svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.7.4.3 Performance Requirements
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.7 WINDOWS, DOORS AND SKYLIGHTS
Performance Requirements

g.text: Table C-5 values may be used
from Table A.1 of CSA A440S1

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Buildings not more than 10 m (32′-9¾″) high,
measured from grade
For compliance with CSA A440S1, windows, doors
and their components may conform to the design
pressure, performance grade and water resistance
values in Table C-5 of Appendix C instead of the
values calculated in CSA A440S1.
Buildings described in Sentence 1.3.3.3.(1) of
Division A
Where those values are calculated with CSA
A440S1, the driving rain wind pressure (DRWP)
values in Table A.1 of CSA A440S1 are used.
Either design route
This applies whether the windows, doors and
skylights are designed to Article 9.7.4.2. or to
Part 5.
Sentences (3) and (4) are reserved
Drawn: a three-storey building with wind-driven rain on its windows. Arrows are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.7.4.3. (page 9-26), with Note A-9.7.4.3.(2).
